correctness.rationale: For every n≥3 the unique-predecessor argument fixes the reset target, the Frobenius number supplies sharp minimality, n−1 and n−2 starting-state trajectories force all compulsory a/b positions, and explicitly defined shrinking cyclic intervals show sufficiency at all other positions. The compulsory sets are disjoint and give the exact binomial enumerator. The n=2 boundary is checked. Independently implemented direct enumeration through n=6 and exact subset-image DP through n=12 support the written infinite proof; no finite check is substituted for it.

value.rationale: A complete parametrization of the entire shortest reset language of a canonical extremal synchronizing family supplies the exact number of minimum-length control strings, their letter-composition distribution, and a constructive description for all n. Prior extremal-length knowledge provides only one statistic and one witness, not these structural and design freedoms. This is not a finite ad hoc slice or a tiny improvement to a known constant.
